title: Verify a user can log in
steps:
1. Open Login page
2. Enter valid username
3. Enter valid password
4. Click the Login button
expected: User is redirected to Dashboard page. Dashboard heading is displayed.

title: Verify a wrong password is rejected
steps:
1. Open Login page
2. Enter valid username
3. Enter wrong password
4. Click Login
expected: Error "Invalid username or password" is shown. User stays on the Login page.

title: Verify the profile can be saved
steps:
1. Open Login page
2. Enter valid username
3. Enter valid password
4. Click Login
5. Click Profile
6. Enter Full name
7. Select India from Country
8. Check Send me news
9. Click Save changes
expected: Message "Profile saved" is shown. Send me news is checked.

title: Verify the reports page opens
steps:
1. Open Login page
2. Enter valid username
3. Enter valid password
4. Click Login
5. Click Reports
